title: 6.6.27 Challenges — Extended State Features
description: Extend your state machine: animated transitions, a loading screen state, state history (undo last transition), or an options/settings state that modifies gameplay.

steps.title: Choose a challenge
steps.instructions: Pick one of the four challenge options from the content below. Each extends your A16.2 state machine with a real game-dev feature.
hints: Read all four before deciding. Pick the one that excites you most — you'll spend 30 minutes on it.

steps.title: Plan your state layout
steps.instructions: Decide whether your challenge adds a new state, modifies transitions, or adds a data structure alongside the state machine. Sketch the switch cases before coding.
hints: If your challenge needs a new case in the switch, name the state clearly: 'loading', 'settings', 'transition', etc.

steps.title: Implement the feature
steps.instructions: Add your challenge to script.js. Start from your A16.2 code. Test that the base states still work before adding the new feature.
hints: Commit your working A16.2 first so you can always go back. Build the challenge on top.

requirements.title: switch statement used
requirements.description: A switch statement controls state routing.

requirements.title: Canvas created
requirements.description: new Canvas() is called in setup().

requirements.title: Multiple cases used
requirements.description: The switch has at least two case blocks.
